#Aletheia #USPol #Healthcare

The error lies in confusing the WHO with the WHAT. A single patient's tragic complication is used to define the safety profile of a medication, ignoring systemic clinical data to justify a political ban.

The Unavoidable Truth: Unsupervised medical procedures carry real physical risks.
